bio: The Stadtgarten Pavilion (1936) has been given a new lease of life with a trendy-chic feel, plus a good dose of glamour! Food is served throughout the day: a modern, ingredient-led take on classic cuisine à la carte at both lunch and dinnertime (somewhat reduced menu at lunchtime). There are also classics such as Wiener schnitzel and beef goulash, plus a small selection of pizzas. In addition, in the evening, a set menu made up of dishes from the à la carte selection is available. Short snack menu served 3-5pm. Lovely terrace overlooking a small park. Very good, wide-ranging wine list. Pino's Bar has a classic vibe and an outdoor lounge....
